collection.title: Isuzu Grafter 2001 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Isuzu Grafter 2001 Onwards model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
